comments: At least 30 local Swifts flying in a tight screaming flock around Central Dunbar
At least one hundred on upper edge of building or near lighthouse, presume staging for migration?
Lone individual in a cut wheat field. Small and dark brown. Can't believe I managed to see a Quail before I've heard one!

Two light brown birds briefly flew from one patch of reeds to another. Got brief views as they moved through the reeds before they disappeared. This species has been seen here earlier this year although it's hard to tell if these are the same birds.
Amazing number on the spit, could easily have been 30 or 40 more!
I nice fresh looking juvenile. Came past fairly close round the spit heading into the bay accompanied by Arctic terns
Female/imm type gaining height, circling and flew South West. Pale crown, longish rounded tail. Distinctive shape, and soaring on broad long wings.
Flew away from me relatively distantly. Flight was Raptor like but it definitely was not one itself.
